
LIST-FEATURE-TAGS
List all tags on a specific feature file

WHEN TO USE
  Use this command when you need to see all tags applied to a feature file, either just the tag names or with their category information from the tag registry.

USAGE
  fspec list-feature-tags <file> [options]

ARGUMENTS
  <file> (required)
    Feature file path (e.g., spec/features/login.feature)

OPTIONS
  --show-categories
    Show tag categories from registry (spec/tags.json)

EXAMPLES
  1. List all tags on a feature file
  $ fspec list-feature-tags spec/features/login.feature
  @critical
@authentication
@cli
@critical

  2. List tags with their categories
  $ fspec list-feature-tags spec/features/login.feature --show-categories
  @critical (Phase Tags)
@authentication (Feature Group Tags)
@cli (Component Tags)
@critical (Priority Tags)

RELATED COMMANDS
  fspec add-tag-to-feature
  fspec remove-tag-from-feature
  fspec list-scenario-tags
  fspec list-tags
  fspec validate-tags

NOTES
  • Shows only tags at the feature level (not scenario-level tags)
  • Use --show-categories to see which category each tag belongs to
  • Tags are displayed in the order they appear in the feature file
